posts.text: One day, I'll tell this story, in testimony, in witness to God's miracles and God's everlasting love.

As heartbroken as I am tonight, today showed me God is real.

Today unfolded exactly as He intended. And it was nothing short of a miracle.

General Mace is now a son of the King.

Rest in peace, Dad. I love you, and I'll see you again. 🕊️🙏❤️
Rest in Peace, General. You are loved. - CNM

Tonight at 9:56 PM, my father went Home.  

In his final moments I read him testimony from his soldiers - words describing his heroism during December 2-4, 1968, the acts that earned him the Distinguished Service Cross with Valor. We had just discovered new testimony from the men who served beside him. As I read those words to him, he grew calm. And then he was gone.  

He left this world knowing he was a war hero. Knowing he was loved. Knowing Jesus was waiting.  

He was surrounded by his two
Praying he passes peacefully, he's earned it.

I sat beside him. Held his hand. Told him everything I needed to say. I gave dad all of my words tonight. We have no unfinished business. A rare and precious gift from God.

Our family also witnessed one of life's most sacred moments, a father finding faith at the end. I'll hold onto this forever.

Our Father who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.

I’m at a loss for a lifetime of words. Sitting beside my dad, grateful for every hard, beautiful, complicated moment we’ve ever had together.

I’ve been praying over him, praying for him to see peace and for his mercy. On Friday I witnessed him accept Christ as his savior. That’s a miracle inside of our grief. 

I’m at a loss for all the words I want to say. The things I haven’t told him yet. 

He’s fought hard. He’s loved deeply. And he’ll be at peace one day soon. 🙏

Eric Swalwell resigned. First smart thing he’s done. Tony Gonzales needs to follow his lead.

We don't care what party you're in. Stealing millions in taxpayer dollars, sexually assaulting your staff, lying about your service record, none of it is acceptable and none of it goes unnoticed.

Swalwell, Gonzales, Mills and McCormick all need to resign immediately. The American people deserve a Congress worthy of their trust. The House needs to be cleaned out, and it starts with these four.

Congress has a predator problem.

Eric Swalwell and Tony Gonzales have no business representing the American people. Neither does any member of Congress sexually harassing the staff working for them. They are betraying every constituent who sent them to Washington and every staffer who deserves a safe workplace.

Power is not a shield. A title is not protection. And taxpayer dollars should never be used to cover up misconduct by the very people entrusted with public service.

Clean house. Expel

357 members of Congress voted to kill our resolution to expose sexual harassment records in Congress.

They chose secrecy over accountability. They chose to protect themselves and their friends.

We tried to bring the truth forward and show the American people what is happening behind closed doors in Congress. Both sides voted to keep these records buried from you.

We won’t forget it, and neither should you.

Congress has such a low bar, the least we could say is r*pists and s*xual predators shouldn’t serve. 

Expel every single one.

California is corrupt enough. At least now they won’t have a sexual predator as their future governor.

Next step: Swalwell should resign from Congress, and if he doesn’t, he should be expelled.

Amnesty is never the answer to illegal immigration, deportations are.

NO to the DIGNIDAD Act.
Members of Congress committing sexual misconduct is egregious enough. Using your tax dollars to cover it up is even worse.
Law and order means the justice system works as hard to protect victims as it does to defend predators.
